name: Vane's Wick Tin
shortDescription: A flat tin of trimmed wicks and a stub of taper.
examineDescription: A flat tin that once held lamp oil and now holds a coil of fresh wick, a stub of taper, and a scrap of the black rag. Vane pressed it into your paws and said a lit stair is worth more than a brave one. The lid does not quite shut, which she says is on purpose so you can hear it rattle and remember you have it.
